messages:
emma: heads-up — noticed canary v2 not getting traffic for customer tier 'startup' even though console shows rollout 5% for that tier. telemetry for v2 is flat. anyone seen this?

sanjay: did you check quota and regional routing? sampling vs quota ordering matters. are we sampling before quota checks or after?

emma: checked quota, tier usage is low so shouldn't be exhausted. rollout is per-tier scoped: 
```\n{\n  "policy": "tiered-canary",\n  "tiers": {"startup": {"exposure": 0.05}, "enterprise": {"exposure": 0.2}},\n  "fallback": "stable-v1"\n}\n```

nora: fwiw we've been doing sample -> preflight capacity -> route. if capacity fails we immediately fallback to stable and do not increment canary exposure metric. that makes the console exposure look like it's applied, but effective exposure = 0.

priya: that's the root cause. console shows "configured exposure" but our telemetry only reports "final_variant" and not "intended_variant". we should add labels so you can see attempted canary hits that fell back. e.g., metric labels: {intended_variant, final_variant, tier, region}.

liam: small API debate: do we change routing runtime to sample after capacity check (so only count successful canary hits), or keep current and add telemetry for attempted exposures? both have trade-offs. sampling after capacity keeps metrics aligned with effective exposure but changes distribution when capacity fluctuates.

emma: prefer adding telemetry first (less risk) + console UX that surfaces attempted exposures vs succeeded exposures. also need to surface when fallback is due to quota vs capacity vs model compatibility.

sanjay: agreed. implement two things: 1) add labels intended_variant & fallback_reason to request-level telemetry; 2) introduce a metric for "attempted_canary_requests" so PMs can see config vs reality.

priya: quick patch for metrics schema: 
```\ncounter("requests_total", labels={"intended_variant":"v2","final_variant":"v1","tier":"startup","region":"eu-west","fallback_reason":"capacity"})\n```

nora: also propose a console change: when you open rollout details show a small table: configured exposure / attempted exposure / successful exposure, with hover for fallback_reason distribution.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: canary-config-v3 -> staging (applied to eu-west) :rocket:

liam: tests: add e2e that simulates capacity fail path and asserts attempted_canary_requests increments even when final_variant is stable. to avoid behaviour drift, keep runtime sampling semantics for now.

emma: ok action items: @sanjay add telemetry labels PR, @priya add metric + dashboard panel, @nora mockup console table, @liam add e2e. I'll follow up and keep thread updated. :+1:

sanjay: on it, will post PR link when ready.

emma: thanks everyone :eyes:
